title: Grateful Dead Live at Ventura County Fairgrounds on 1982-07-17

ai_review.summary: Vivid audience recording captures a sun‑kissed Ventura show with a smoking first set—Truckin', China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider, Estimated Prophet and The Wheel—though the second set loses a bit of steam.
ai_review.review: The tape delivers a clear, well‑balanced audience sound that brings listeners right onto the beach stage where the Dead rode a perfect summer breeze. The first set shines with tight jams on Truckin', China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider and a fiery Estimated Prophet, while the second set starts strong but tapers off in energy for some listeners. Jerry’s nuanced guitar work and Bob’s raspy vocals are repeatedly highlighted, even as Phil receives mixed remarks.

ai_rating.rationale: Average star rating is 4.2; most reviewers praise both performance and recording quality with only a few negative comments about later‑set energy and Phil’s playing.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as a wonderful sounding AUD with clear ambience; no major dropouts or distortion noted, but it is not a pristine soundboard capture.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
Rockin' Bertha > Greatest Story Ever Told
poor_songs: Estimated Prophet (middle re‑entry) – noted as rough by some listeners
show_quality.setlist_flow: A high‑energy first set that flows tightly, followed by a second set that starts with Estimated Prophet but loses a bit of momentum compared to other summer ’82 shows.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for nuanced chord soloing in Rider and strong lead work on The Wheel; tone described as fine and expressive.
band_member_comments.Phil: Mixed feedback – some enjoy his power, but others find his later playing odd, over‑playing and a bit disjointed.
band_member_comments.Bob: His raspy vocal style highlighted during the Reprise and Around sections, adding extra flavor.
